experiment: Search for an accessible ToN_IoT mirror
setup: Kaggle and Hugging Face copies require credentials or are blocked
result: Located public GitHub mirrors for the IoT telemetry and the Zeek flows
decision: Cloned both; documented the clone commands in the README

experiment: Check whether the flow mirror carries timestamps
setup: 44 columns inspected
result: No `ts` column in this mirror
decision: Recorded as defect D01; cross-source joins use address and asset instead of time

experiment: Choose an identity/access source for C2
setup: ToN_IoT has no login records; the charter forbids real credentials
result: Wrote a documented synthetic generator with a fixed seed
decision: Accepted, with the synthetic status stated in every product

experiment: Country codes in the access log
setup: ISO-2 code 'NA' used for Namibia
result: pandas read 'NA' as missing, so every user-day looked foreign (100% flagged)
decision: Switched to ISO-3 codes and added a regression test (defect D02)

experiment: Handle Zeek '-' placeholders
setup: 211,043 flows, 16 columns above 97% empty
result: Left as text the placeholder becomes an artificial predictor
decision: Converted to missing; sparse columns excluded from features

experiment: Compare LR, decision tree and random forest
setup: 3-fold CV F1 on the training split only
decision: Random Forest selected; the other two kept as interpretable comparators

experiment: Duplicate leakage check
setup: 20,569 exact duplicates found
result: Removing them before the split changes the evaluation honestly
decision: Duplicates flagged in the data and excluded from train and test

experiment: Modbus telemetry classifier
setup: Registers plus hour and day-of-week features
result: RF F1 0.9887 against LR 0.5825
decision: Kept both to show that the OT signal is non-linear

experiment: Isolation Forest on flows, fully unsupervised
setup: 80,000-flow sample, contamination 0.15
result: ROC-AUC 0.279 - below chance because attacks are the majority class
decision: Kept and reported as a finding rather than discarded

experiment: Isolation Forest fitted on known-good traffic only
setup: 60% of normal flows used for fitting, remainder held out
result: ROC-AUC 0.716 on held-out flows
decision: Adopted as the realistic framing for an OT site

experiment: LOF as a contrasting method on user-days
setup: 25 neighbours, same feature set as the Isolation Forest
result: ROC-AUC 0.501 versus 0.997 for IF
decision: IF retained for the prototype; LOF reported as a negative comparison

experiment: Threshold for the failed-login burst rule
setup: Baseline 99th percentile is 2 failures per day; no account exceeded 3 per hour
result: A threshold of 5 per hour produced no alerts at all
decision: Lowered to 3 per hour, justified against the measured baseline

experiment: Out-of-hours privileged action rule (R4)
setup: Per-account 5th-95th percentile working window
result: 99 alerts at 4% precision against injected behaviour
decision: Kept deliberately as the tuning counter-example; flagged as defect D07

experiment: First network graph was too densely connected
setup: 3,547 edges, 20 steps
result: Every scenario compromised about 177 of 195 assets, so controls looked useless
decision: Sparsened the OT and IT meshes, lowered base probabilities, shortened the horizon

experiment: MFA modelled on internal edges
setup: MFA factor applied to the gateway edge
result: No effect, because the foothold node is already compromised at step 0
decision: Moved the MFA effect onto the foothold probability, which is where it acts

experiment: Final scenario comparison
setup: 5 scenarios x 5,000 runs, Wilson intervals
result: P(reach OT): baseline 0.541 to combined 0.100
decision: Ranking stable across all sensitivity scales

experiment: Ticket classification
setup: TF-IDF (1-2 grams) with logistic regression, 30% held out
result: macro-F1 1.000 - optimistic because the corpus is template-generated
decision: Kept, with the caveat recorded in the outputs and repeated in the report

experiment: Indicator extraction scored against an answer key
setup: Regular expressions plus an ATT&CK malware gazetteer
result: precision 0.972, recall 0.997
decision: Accepted; false positives come from extra entities not in the answer key

experiment: Risk band cut-points
setup: Components are percentile ranks, so an average account scores about 50
result: Fixed cut-points put 44% of user-days in the 'high' band
decision: Cut-points moved to score quantiles (0.900, 0.980, 0.995) as an alert budget

experiment: Next-day early warning
setup: Time-ordered split, logistic regression on day-level features
result: ROC-AUC 0.528 against a base rate of 0.082
decision: Reported as a negative result rather than tuned until it looked better

experiment: First robustness baseline was computed on training rows
setup: 40,000-row sample drawn from the whole dataset
result: Reference F1 was inflated relative to the true held-out score
decision: Stage-08 split reproduced exactly; only test rows are perturbed (defect D04)

experiment: Four perturbation families
setup: Drift, evasion, missing data, label poisoning, three severities each
result: Largest loss is missing data at 50% (F1 -0.23); evasion costs almost nothing
decision: Evasion test recorded as insufficient; backlog item B02

experiment: End-to-end reproducibility run
setup: 18 stages from raw data to compliance checklist
result: Completed in 135 seconds; 16 test cases pass
decision: Accepted as the Milestone 2 baseline
